# Wharf 0.7.0 changes

- Added `DerivedImageRequest`, `DerivedImageResult`, and
  `IDerivedImageBackend` under `Wharf.Image`.
- Added deterministic SHA-256 cache keys over base image, scripts, versions,
  and configuration.
- Added `DerivedImageCoordinator` with one complete `B` gate spanning base
  preparation, context preparation, and derived image build.
- Added normal cache reuse, identical in-flight build coalescing, force-build
  bypass, caller-only cancellation, and failed-build cleanup.
- Added focused concurrency, cancellation, deduplication, cache, and failure
  tests.
